title: Adding & subtracting有理式加减

quiz.q: Simplify x2​+x+13​.化简 x2​+x+13​。
opts: x(x+1)5x+2​
2x+15​
x(x+1)5​
x(x+1)5x+1​
quiz.hint: LCD x(x+1); multiply each top by what its bottom is missing.公分母 x(x+1)；每个分子乘上它分母缺的因式。
quiz.why: Correct: x(x+1)2(x+1)+3x​=x(x+1)5x+2​.正确：x(x+1)2(x+1)+3x​=x(x+1)5x+2​。
whys: Correct: x(x+1)2(x+1)+3x​=x(x+1)5x+2​.正确：x(x+1)2(x+1)+3x​=x(x+1)5x+2​。
Added tops and added bottoms; only numerators over a common denominator add.分子加分子、分母加分母了；只有同分母后分子才相加。
Used the common denominator but did not multiply the numerators by the missing factors.用了公分母，却没把分子乘上缺的因式。
Partial distribution: 2(x+1)=2x+2, not 2x+1.分配不完整：2(x+1)=2x+2，不是 2x+1。

quiz.q: Simplify x−2x+3​−x+2x+1​.化简 x−2x+3​−x+2x+1​。
opts: (x−2)(x+2)4x+4​
(x−2)(x+2)2​
(x−2)(x+2)4x+8​
(x−2)(x+2)2(3x+4)​
quiz.hint: LCD (x−2)(x+2); bracket the second product before subtracting.公分母 (x−2)(x+2)；第二个乘积先加括号再相减。
quiz.why: Correct: (x2+5x+6)−(x2−x−2)=6x+8=2(3x+4).正确：(x2+5x+6)−(x2−x−2)=6x+8=2(3x+4)。
whys: Did not distribute the minus: −(x2−x−2)=−x2+x+2.减号没分配：−(x2−x−2)=−x2+x+2。
Subtracted the numerators directly without first rewriting over the LCD.没先通分就直接把分子相减了。
Expansion slip: (x+1)(x−2)=x2−x−2, not x2+x−2.展开错：(x+1)(x−2)=x2−x−2，不是 x2+x−2。
Correct: (x2+5x+6)−(x2−x−2)=6x+8=2(3x+4).正确：(x2+5x+6)−(x2−x−2)=6x+8=2(3x+4)。

quiz.q: Simplify x−23​−x+12​.化简 x−23​−x+12​。
quiz.hint: LCD (x−2)(x+1).最简公分母 (x−2)(x+1)。
quiz.ans: (x−2)(x+1)x+7​, x=2,−1(x−2)(x+1)x+7​，x=2,−1
quiz.why: (x−2)(x+1)3(x+1)−2(x−2)​=(x−2)(x+1)3x+3−2x+4​=(x−2)(x+1)x+7​.(x−2)(x+1)3(x+1)−2(x−2)​=(x−2)(x+1)3x+3−2x+4​=(x−2)(x+1)x+7​。

quiz.q: A cyclist rides 60 km uphill to a lookout at x km/h and returns the same 60 km downhill at (x+10) km/h. (a) Write the total time as one fraction, simplified, and state the restrictions in context. (b) Write the average speed for the whole trip, total time120​, as a single simplified expression. (c) For x=20 find the average speed and explain why it is not the mean of 20 and 30.一名骑行者以 x km/h 的速度上坡骑 60 km 到观景台，再以 (x+10) km/h 的速度下坡骑回同样的 60 km。(a) 把总时间写成一个化简后的分式，并说明情境下的限制。(b) 把全程平均速度 总时间120​ 写成一个化简的式子。(c) 当 x=20 时求平均速度，并解释为什么它不是 20 与 30 的平均数。
quiz.hint: LCD is x(x+10). Average speed is total distance over total time.公分母是 x(x+10)。平均速度 = 总路程 ÷ 总时间。
quiz.ans: (a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ h, x>0; (b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​; (c) 24 km/h.(a) T=x(x+10)60(2x+10)​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​ 小时，x>0；(b) vˉ=x+5x(x+10)​；(c) 24 km/h。
quiz.why: T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​. Speeds are positive, so x>0 (and x=0,−10 is automatic).T=x60​+x+1060​=x(x+10)60(x+10)+60x​=x(x+10)120(x+5)​。速度为正，所以 x>0（x=0,−10 自然满足）。
